2026-DC-MAYOR.office: Mayor of the District of Columbia
2026-DC-MAYOR.why: No ballot list carries the District of Columbia; the Mayor's contest is tied by its title in the Board of Elections' own file.

rule: A contest is tied to a race only when exactly one race of the same office and district (and seat) fits. A candidate line is tied to a name as filed only when exactly one fits: the family name and a given name that fits. Everything else is listed with the reason and never shown.
source: The ballot databases (Congress, and state and local), read only; the races and the names as filed.
